# Asia Briefing

> > Asia Briefing provides comprehensive business intelligence, regulatory guides, and practical resources for companies operating across Asia, with focus on China, Vietnam, and cross-border operations.

Asia Briefing is a trusted resource for foreign investors and businesses navigating Asian markets, offering detailed guides on taxation, transfer pricing, regulatory compliance, and city-specific business intelligence. The platform serves as a knowledge hub for understanding complex cross-border transactions and regional business environments.

## Key Topics

- Transfer Pricing
- Cross-Border Transactions
- China Regulation
- Vietnam Business Environment
- Inter-Company Transactions
- Documentation Requirements
- Hanoi
- Red River Delta
- South China Sea Region
- Foreign Direct Investment
- Tax Compliance
- City Guides
- Regional Investment
- Asia Pacific Markets

## Transfer Pricing & Tax Compliance

- [Transfer Pricing in Cross-Border Inter-Company Transactions](https://www.asiabriefing.com/store/book-share/transfer-pricing-cross-border-inter-company-transactions-50): Comprehensive guide to transfer pricing regulations and documentation requirements for cross-border inter-company transactions in China

## City & Regional Business Guides

- [City Guide: Hanoi](https://www.asiabriefing.com/store/book-share/city-guide--hanoi-269): Detailed business and investment guide for Hanoi, Vietnam, covering the Red River Delta and South China Sea region
